messages:
jess: FYI I opened PR #7421 that updates the on-prem auth scopes + VPC egress rules for the onprem-agent. Need a security sign-off before merge. https://git.internal/repo/pull/7421

oliver: quick skimed — terraform changes look reasonable but flagged the iam role for broad perms. Can you tighten the assume-role/principal? Also check KMS policy alias usage.

sam: pinging @security-bot for automated scan + any egress warnings.

security-bot: secret-scan: no secrets found. infra-lint: added egress rule -> flagged: `wide_cidr` (recommend narrow CIDR or documented justification). audit-log: flagged 'kms_policy' change for manual review.

nina: what's the destination for the egress? if it's telemetry can we tunnel via private peering/NAT instead of opening a wide block?

jess: destination is `redwood-telemetry.<region>.svc` from the onprem-agent. We're trying to avoid public internet egress for regulated customers. Current PR adds 10.0.0.0/16 which is admittedly too wide.

oliver: VPC peering requires customer-side routing changes. This PR touches only our onprem bundle. We could instead ship an optional `use_peering` flag and keep default conservative.

sam: security checklist: 1) KMS envelope flow documented 2) no plaintext creds in logs 3) feature gated for staged rollout 4) tests that assert no broad egress in default config.

jess: will add docs + acceptance test. timeline: trying to merge today to run a canary tomorrow — is that OK?

nina: I'd like at least one manual sec approval + infra LGTM before merging. I can review in ~30m.

oliver: I'll rebase after the docs/test commits. :thumbsup:

security-bot: audit-log: PR7421 -> issues: ["broad_egress", "kms_policy_change"] -> manual review requested.

sam: also double-check the KMS key usage: does this assume customer-managed key or ours? If customer, ensure aliasing & key policy are explicit.

jess: it's customer-key optional; default is our managed key. I'll add a note and explicit policy snippet. Also moving egress to a narrower CIDR per infra suggestion.

nina: if you add gating + docs + tests I'll approve. please ping when updated.

jess: pushed docs + a small acceptance test that asserts `egress.cidr_blocks == ["10.1.0.0/24"]` by default and feature flag `onprem.egress_proxy=false`. Re-requesting reviews. PR link updated.

oliver: reviewed new diffs. KMS policy tightened, terraform comments clear, tests look fine. infra LGTM.

sam: Security review: KMS flow ok for default managed-key, customer-key path documented, egress narrowed to `10.1.0.0/24`, feature flag present, no secrets in code. I'm good to approve.

nina: Approve. Merge window open — plan canary deployment at 15:00 UTC if merged.

jess: Thanks — merging in 10m to allow any final calls.

security-bot: deploy-bot: PR #7421 merged by jess at 2061234820. Canary scheduled for 15:00 UTC.

jess: merged and will monitor canary. thanks everyone for quick turnaround!
